A's variant-token approach for the buttons is tidy and keeps the cascade correct, but it leaves font sizes, card spacing and gaps as hard-coded literals, so it falls short of the main goal of building future components from shared values. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Answer A turns every repeated value into a variable, including spacing, font sizes, weights and motion. Answer B leaves spacing and font sizes as literals, and its --btn-* variant pattern is extra structure nobody asked for.
